1.explanation:
1. Notification/Notification.mdx – the main Markdown doc for the Notification component; it shows the API table where "caption" is listed, so we can reconcile the docs vs. implementation.
2. Notification/docs/overview.mdx – the overview docs that introduce the Notification variants; it may mention or link to the Actionable variant.
3. Notification/stories/Actionable/Playground.js – the Storybook playground story file where the "caption" control is declared and driven in live code; reproducing the bug requires this story.
4. src/components/Notification/ActionableNotification.js – the source of the actionable notification; it declares PropTypes.caption but does not render it, which is the root cause.
5. src/components/Notification/index.js – the entry point that exports the ActionableNotification component; verifying that no wrapper or higher‐order component is adding caption logic.
6. Notification/stories/Actionable/Default.js – the default story for the actionable notification; used to compare base functionality and verify that caption is not rendered here either.
1.bug_scenario:
The bug shows that the ActionableNotification component in the @carbon/react docs declares a "caption" prop (for e.g. a timestamp or caption text) in its propTypes and in the playground interface, but when you supply a value for this prop nothing renders. In the screenshot you can see:
- The Storybook playground control for ActionableNotification lists "caption: string"
- In the live preview, you pass caption="Caption not working." but it never appears under the subtitle or anywhere in the notification panel.
- The underlying component code (around lines 649–663) defines PropTypes.caption but never uses it in the JSX render tree.

The elements involved are:
- The ActionableNotification panel container
- The subtitle text
- The (missing) caption text area
- The action button
- The prop control in the Storybook playground UI
